title: I Built slothd: A Local-First, Offline-Capable AI Daemon That Patiently Organizes Your Messy Workspace
why_read: A hackathon submission describing a local AI file-organizing daemon, with promotional framing that outweighs genuine technical depth.
analysis: This describes a local, offline AI tool that organizes a messy workspace using a two-stage pipeline combining a tabular metadata model (TabPFN) and Gemma 3 vision model running via Ollama. The architecture of cheap metadata triage followed by a heavier local vision model is a reasonable practical pattern for local-first AI tools. However, the writeup is heavily templated for a hackathon challenge with excessive navigation and marketing framing, diluting the technical substance. It may interest readers exploring local AI agent architectures but requires digging past the promotional structure.
